disclaim.definition:
v. renounce a legal claim or title to
v. make a disclaimer about
disclaim.translation: v. 放弃, 弃权, 拒绝承认

disclaim liability.translation: [经] 否定责任, 否认责任, 不索取的债务

disclaimatory.translation: a. 否认的, 表示否认的

disclaimed.translation: v. 否认( disclaim的过去式和过去分词 )

disclaimer.definition: n. (law) a voluntary repudiation of a person's legal claim to something
disclaimer.translation:
n. 放弃, 拒负责任, 不承诺
[经] 弃权或不申诉条款

disclaimer by patentee.translation: [法] 专利权人放弃专利权

disclaimer of onerous property.translation: [法] 放弃负有法律义务的财产

disclaimer of trustee.translation: [法] 受托管理人的弃权书

disclaimers.definition:
n. (law) a voluntary repudiation of a person's legal claim to something
n. denial of any connection with or knowledge of
disclaimers.translation: n. 放弃( disclaimer的复数形式 ); 拒绝; 放弃者; 免责声明

disclaiming.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Disclaim
disclaiming.translation: v. 否认( disclaim的现在分词 )

disclaims.definition:
v renounce a legal claim or title to
v make a disclaimer about
disclaims.translation: v. 否认( disclaim的第三人称单数 )

disclamation.translation: n. (权利等的)放弃, 否认

disclocse.translation: [计] 汇密, 解密, 公开

disclose.definition: v. disclose to view as by removing a cover
disclose.translation:
vt. 揭露, 透露
[法] 揭发, 揭露, 公开

disclosed.definition: s. made known (especially something secret or concealed)
disclosed.translation: v. 说出( disclose的过去式和过去分词 ); 揭露; 使显露; 使暴露

disclosed ballot.translation: [法] 记名投票, 无封投票, 公开投票

discloser.translation: n. 揭露者（disclose的名词形式）

discloses.definition:
v make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret
v disclose to view as by removing a cover
discloses.translation: v. 说出( disclose的第三人称单数 ); 揭露; 使显露; 使暴露

disclosing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Disclose
disclosing.translation: v. 说出( disclose的现在分词 ); 揭露; 使显露; 使暴露

disclosure.definition: n. the speech act of making something evident
disclosure.translation:
n. 揭发, 泄露, 揭发(或暴露)的事实
[经] 揭示, 披露

disclosures.definition: n. the speech act of making something evident
disclosures.translation: n. 公开( disclosure的复数形式 ); 透露; 被公开的事情; 被披露的秘闻
